parent_reads: Broad read access; no per-fixture read isolation.
parent_network: Restricted by default; approved require_escalated executions launch actual Codex evaluation runtime.
role_runtime: Fresh codex exec processes, ephemeral sessions, ignore-user-config and ignore-rules. Normal Codex account authentication is used by the runtime, not exposed to fixture tools.
role_controls: Per-phase CLI sandbox and network/approval settings are recorded in dispatch JSON. No escalation approval is available to evaluated role tools.
observed_limits: Command/tool event review and before/after hashes; no kernel syscall auditing, adversarial proof of sandbox isolation, or control over shell implicit runtime reads. CLI read-only policy is configured, not inferred from a role label.
public_artifacts: Filtered tool events, final messages, hashes, sanitized fixtures, and results; reasoning items discarded.
